title: Jacobian-Velocity Bounds for Deployment Risk Under Covariate Drift
abstract: arXiv:2605.04932v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study long-horizon deployment of a frozen predictor under dynamic covariate shift. A time-domain Poincar\'e inequality first reduces temporal risk volatility to derivative energy, and a Jacobian-velocity theorem supplies the corresponding pathwise control. A remainder extension separates the model-mediated, controllable term from conditional-risk variation not transmitted through the score Jacobian. Under low-rank drift, the bound decomposes the controllable term into tangent energy parallel and orthogonal to the drift subspace. This motivates drift-aligned tangent regularization (DTR), its anisotropic extension with a weaker orthogonal guardrail, and a matched monitoring proxy. Controlled experiments verify the temporal inequality, the efficiency of directional smoothing, and the necessity of the remainder term. translated_title: 协变量漂移下部署风险的雅可比-速度界
translated_abstract: 我们研究了冻结预测器在动态协变量偏移下的长期部署问题。首先，一个时域庞加莱（Poincaré）不等式将时间上的风险波动性归约为导数能量，随后由雅可比-速度定理提供相应的逐路径控制。通过余项扩展，我们将经由模型介导的可控项与未通过得分雅可比传递的条件风险变化分离开来。在低秩漂移条件下，该界将可控项分解为平行和正交于漂移子空间的切向能量。这一结果启发了漂移对齐切向正则化（DTR）、其带有较弱正交护栏的各向异性扩展，以及与之相匹配的监控代理指标。受控实验验证了该时间不等式、方向性平滑的高效性以及余项的必要性。主要的实地研究采用一个128维气体传感器阵列在十个按时间顺序排列的批次上进行。一个秩为4的基估计……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文通过时域庞加莱不等式与雅可比-速度定理建立了协变量漂移下冻结预测器长期部署的风险上界，并据此提出漂移对齐切向正则化（DTR）及配套监控指标来有效控制部署风险。
en_tdlr: This paper derives Jacobian-velocity bounds on the deployment risk of frozen predictors under covariate drift via a time-domain Poincaré inequality, and proposes drift-aligned tangent regularization (DTR) with a matched monitoring proxy to control long-horizon deployment risk.
